summary: Exact-type audit separates logical holding from the unchanged proof/assertion-policy package. Lean types and frozen Challenges are unchanged. Owner-directed endpoint repair: added exact analyst global complement ¬∀pEM(p), kept unrefuted and unattributed to intuitionism; moved the full serious withholding position to its actual universal-assertion target while preserving the exact negative policy alternative too. Updated floor disagreement metadata without changing its basis/justification. Focused actual-record frontier regression removes the legacy floor and verifies no EM defense follows from instance-denial refutation; with the legacy floor retained its established status is unchanged. The broader finite-rival-coverage limitation remains.
